user.title: Connect to Montana-Dakota Utilities
user.description: Sign in with the username and password you use for MDU Online Account Services (customer.montana-dakota.com).

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to MDU again
reauth_confirm.description: MDU no longer accepts the saved sign-in for {username}. Enter your current password. If MDU asks for a security code, you'll be prompted next.

mfa_contact.title: Security code
mfa_contact.description: MDU wants a security code to finish signing in. Choose where to send it. Home Assistant asks MDU to trust this connection, so you shouldn't be asked again unless MDU forgets it.

mfa_code.title: Enter the security code
mfa_code.description: Enter the 5-digit code MDU just sent.

account.title: Choose an account
account.description: Your sign-in has more than one MDU account. Pick the one to add; add the integration again for the others.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach MDU Online Account Services. Try again later.
error.invalid_auth: MDU rejected the username or password.
error.mfa_no_contacts: MDU asked for a security code but has no email or phone on file to send it to. Sign in on the MDU website to fix this.
error.mfa_send_failed: MDU couldn't send the security code. Try again.
error.mfa_invalid_code: That code is incorrect. Try again or go back to request a new one.
error.mfa_code_expired: That code has expired. Start again to get a new one.
error.mfa_too_many_attempts: Too many incorrect codes. Start again to get a new one.
error.mfa_cannot_connect: MDU couldn't check the code. Try again.

abort.already_configured: This MDU account is already configured.
abort.no_accounts: No accounts were found for this sign-in.
abort.account_missing: The account this entry was set up with isn't available to this sign-in anymore.
